Stage 0 normal: grasp 107-112, lifted 15 cm and carried 50 cm (base and arm moving, 120-232); stage 0 from 112. Stage 1: the sponge came down on the left part of the board at ~232-248 (z at its resting height on this board), and stayed pressed there while sliding ~9 cm right during 256-304, but finger_joint1 was at its open limit 250-307, so grasp was False and nothing was counted. Counter 1 at 308; then one slow pass to the right edge of the board (316-344, counter 2 at 341), the sponge partly over the counter at 344-376, released at 379 on the board's right edge (eef > 15 cm at 398). Final 2 contacts, sweep 0.182. It was one slow left-to-right pass, not a back-and-forth scrub. 400-800: arm up, looking around, no further attempt.
